- Notes: Companion to the `acpx` CLI installed via mise (`npm:acpx`); it is a headless ACP client, not a subagent. Custom model shortcut families (`agpt*`/`aopus*`/`afable*`/`agemini`) live in `~/.acpx/config.json`, each gated on its backing CLI via machines.toml `agent_clis`. See ~/.agents/docs/acpx.md.
